description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to filesystem monitoring, specifically checking the suitability of the filesystem for Unix domain socket communication in the context of a Git FSMonitor feature. It defines functions to determine filesystem characteristics and compatibility for IPC mechanisms in a repository.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason check_uds_volume(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem volume associated with the repository supports Unix domain sockets, returning an enum indicating compatibility or specific reasons for incompatibility.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason fsm_os__incompatible(struct repository * r,int ipc)
methods.description: Determines whether the repository's filesystem is compatible with IPC via Unix domain sockets, considering remote setups and filesystem types.
